opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guest count and sort
opportunities.description: Search Kayak for hotels in a given destination for a given check-in/check-out date range and guest/room count, then sort or filter the results.
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'.
Type the destination into the 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' textbox.
Click the matching suggestion.
Click the check-in date, then the check-out date, in the calendar.
Click 'Search'.
Open 'Number of rooms and guests', click 'Increment' until the target adult/child/room counts are reached, then click 'Update'.
Apply a sort (e.g. 'Distance', then 'Price (low to high)') and optional filters (star rating, amenities, style).
parameters: optional result filters (star rating, amenities, style)

instances.values: Destination 'Le Marais, Paris, France'; dates day 27 to day 2; guests incremented twice; sorted by Distance, then 'Price (low to high)'.
Destination 'Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States'; dates 16 to 18; guests incremented twice; no sort recorded.
Destination 'Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi'; dates 6 to 10 (lower confidence on which search these date clicks belong to); guests incremented three times.
Destination 'Los Angeles'; dates 21 to 23; filters 8+ stars, 3, Free internet, Family style, Air-conditioned; sorted by 'Price (low to high)'.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search (origin, destination, date, passengers, cabin)
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways for one-way flights from an origin to a destination on a given departure date, set passenger counts and cabin class, then select a fare.
steps: Enter the origin in the 'From' autocomplete textbox and click the matching suggestion.
Enter the destination in the 'To' autocomplete textbox and click the matching suggestion (or pick it from the Explore page).
Click the departure date textbox and click the target date in the calendar grid.
Click 'Continue' if prompted.
Open 'Passengers / Class', adjust adult/child/infant counts and cabin, then click 'Confirm'.
Click 'Show flights'.
Click the fare heading and then 'Select fare'.

instances.values: Origin 'Colombo'; destination 'New York'; departure 24 June 2023; one child added, Business/First cabin; selected a LKR fare.
Destination 'Durban' picked from Explore (Africa); origin 'Doha'; departure 28 May 2023; one infant added; selected a QAR 4,980 fare.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search (destination, dates, guests, sort)
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways Book > Hotels for a destination with check-in and check-out dates and a guest/room count, sort results by price, and reserve a room.
steps: Click 'Book'.
Click 'Hotels'.
Type the destination into the 'Please type your destination' searchbox and click the matching option.
Click the check-in date in the calendar, then set the stay length or check-out date.
Click 'Search'.
Set guests and rooms via the guest selector and click 'Done'.
Sort results by price ('Sort by' > 'Price (lowest first)') when needed.
Click 'See availability', then 'Reserve' on the chosen room.

instances.values: Destination 'Las Vegas Nevada'; check-in 10 April 2023, check-out 16 April 2023; sorted by 'Price (lowest first)'.
Destination 'Washington District of Columbia'; check-in 5 June 2023 with a 1-day stay; 2 adults, 0 children, 1 room; ended with 'Reserve'.
